mapper.insert: INSERT INTO dish (restaurant_id, category_id, dish_name, cover_img_url, dish_status, price, unit, summary, sort_num, create_time, update_time, is_deleted) VALUES (#{restaurantId}, #{categoryId}, #{dishName}, #{coverImgUrl}, #{dishStatus}, #{price}, #{unit}, #{summary}, #{sortNum}, NOW(), NOW(), 0)
mapper.update: UPDATE dish SET restaurant_id = #{restaurantId}, category_id = #{categoryId}, dish_name = #{dishName}, cover_img_url = #{coverImgUrl}, dish_status = #{dishStatus}, price = #{price}, unit = #{unit}, summary = #{summary}, sort_num = #{sortNum}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 0
UPDATE dish SET is_deleted = 1, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 0
mapper.select:
SELECT d.id, d.restaurant_id, d.category_id, r.name AS restaurant_name, dc.category_name, d.dish_name,
CASE WHEN d.cover_img_url IS NOT NULL AND d.cover_img_url != '' THEN CONCAT('/uploads/', d.cover_img_url) ELSE d.cover_img_url END AS cover_img_url, d.dish_status, d.price, d.unit, d.summary, d.create_time, d.update_time FROM dish d LEFT JOIN restaurant r ON d.restaurant_id = r.id LEFT JOIN dish_category dc ON d.category_id = dc.id WHERE d.is_deleted = 0
AND d.dish_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{dishName}, '%')
AND r.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{restaurantName}, '%')
AND dc.category_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{categoryName}, '%')
AND d.dish_status = #{status}
ORDER BY r.create_time DESC, d.sort_num ASC, d.create_time DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dish d LEFT JOIN restaurant r ON d.restaurant_id = r.id LEFT JOIN dish_category dc ON d.category_id = dc.id WHERE d.is_deleted = 0
AND d.dish_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{dishName}, '%')
AND r.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{restaurantName}, '%')

mapper.update: UPDATE dish SET sort_num = #{sortNum}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 0
